gaps.required: 640 slices (Sec. 3.1). Local files pack four SIRs each, so 640 polluted slices or 640 files would satisfy the count.
8 interference patterns with varying parameters (Sec. 3.1). The parameter values are not published.

figure9_claim_reason: Figure 9 is a plot without a numeric table, and the paper does not publish the train/test slice list. A matching file count would still not identify Figure 9.
split_status: The scene holdout in configs/splits/rfipatch_rfi1_seed42_frozen.json is a local assignment (seed 42, about 10% validation and 10% test). The paper does not publish its split. New scenes found on disk are assigned by sample_seed and never share a label image with another part.
how_to_obtain_dataset: Download the laboratory set from the authors' repository (https://github.com/fangfuping/SAR-RFI-DATASET). The README links a Baidu archive (https://pan.baidu.com/s/14BjmzpkJREBbmaAOPyjbyg?pwd=nh3f, code nh3f). Unpack every RFI-* folder of .mat files under Data/RFI-Patch. The loader already reads every RFI-*/*.mat it finds. Do not synthesize the missing patterns: Section 2 gives the chirp imaging model and Table 2 gives only the bandwidth range 0–100 MHz and the four SIRs. The eight parameter tuples, block placements, scene list, and seeds are not in the paper or the released code.
not_synthesized_because: Section 2 derives the block-interference image model. Table 2 specifies bandwidth 0–100 MHz and SIRs [0.0, -10.0, -20.0, -30.0] dB. It does not give the eight patterns' chirp rates, amplitudes, positions, or the Sentinel scenes they were added to. Filling those in would be a new dataset, not the paper's.
